# vibescoder.dev

> Building in public with AI agents. A technical blog by Rob Whiteley, CEO of Coder, documenting the experience of building software with AI coding agents.

## About
- Author: Rob Whiteley, CEO of Coder (https://coder.com)
- Focus: AI-assisted software development, agentic coding, local LLMs, developer tools
- Stack: Next.js, Vercel, MDX, Tailwind CSS
- Content type: Technical blog posts, benchmarks, how-to guides, build journals

## What This Site Covers
- Real-world experiences building software with AI coding agents
- Benchmarking local vs cloud LLMs for coding tasks
- Setting up self-hosted AI development environments (GPU, models, infrastructure)
- Building and deploying with agentic coding tools (Coder workspaces, Claude, etc.)
- Practical guides for developer tooling, homelab setup, and workflow automation
- The "vibe coding" methodology — building entirely through AI conversation
